verdict.rationale: Foreloop's documented model explicitly requires the developer to run the agent (Claude Code or Codex) locally 'on your own machine' in a checkout of the repository, with Foreloop only coordinating tasks via API/MCP — this is the opposite of a managed cloud runtime that executes agents on the vendor's infrastructure. [2026-09-30 judge-migration owner-product bias audit: reverted opus-5-5 partial q3 -> the committed sonnet-5 baseline none q0. The story is running agents in a managed cloud without own infrastructure; the pack's own docs say the coding agents run in a checkout on your own machine — direct counter-evidence. A hosted coordination layer and product-internal review/intention agents are a different capability than managed execution of your agents. Ultrametric-affiliation governance, README §9.]
